--ai-agent.help: Enable agentic AI workflow (iterative tool-calling loop)

--ai-agent-max-steps.help: Maximum steps for AI agent loop (default: `20`)

--ai-native-tools-allowlist.help: Provider allowlist for native tool-calling (comma-separated, default: `openai,xai,github`)

--ai-provider.help: AI provider prefix (e.g., `openai`, `ollama`, `acp:codex`) or custom API URL

--config-file.help: Specify the path to a configuration file in YAML format

--diff-path.help: Specify the path to the old version of the source code for comparison

--exclude-techs.help: Exclude the specified technologies from the scan.

--export-opensearch.help: speaks the same HTTP protocol as Elasticsearch.

--export-webhook.help: POSTs the endpoint catalog as a single JSON document (`{endpoints, endpoint_count, noir_version}`) to any HTTP receiver (Slack incoming webhooks, Discord, Zapier/n8n, custom internal endpoints).

--include-path.help: Include file path in the plain result

--ollama.help: Set the Ollama server URL. Use `--ai-provider` instead.

--ollama-model.help: Specify the model for the Ollama server. Use `--ai-model` instead.

--only-techs.help: Restrict auto-detection to these tech detectors (comma-separated, e.g., `rails,django`).

--passive-scan-no-update-check.help: Skip update checks (useful for air-gapped environments)

--set-pvalue.help: Specifies the value of the identified parameter

--techs.help: Add these techs to the analyzer set in addition to auto-detected ones (comma-separated, e.g., `rails,django`).

--use-all-taggers.help: Activates all taggers for full analysis coverage

--use-filters.help: Exclude matching endpoints (URL, method, or method:URL)

--use-matchers.help: Only send matching endpoints (URL, method, or method:URL)
